name: Hero Divine Star flies out thirty yards then returns to its origin (#7364)
contract: AscensionSummonedEffects.h): the anchor creature 840056 launches on the caster's facing toward
GetFirstCollisionPosition(30, 0) and, on MovementInform at that outbound point, immediately issues the return
leg back to the owner's position (AscensionSummonedEffects.cpp Launch/MovementInform). The travel time is
min(duration(760061)=3000ms, duration(760060)=6000ms) halved for OutAndBack = 1500ms one-way, so the full
round trip is 3000ms, matching 760061's own 3000ms duration and the tooltip's claim that the star heals
allies on its way out and on its way back to its original position. This is an independent expectation from
the DBC duration fields, not from reading whether the current code happens to schedule the return.

steps.label: SETUP: the Divine Star anchor summon exists right after cast
Let the outbound leg (1500 ms) mostly complete
DISCRIMINATING: the star is still alive and well away from its origin mid-flight, not vanished early
Let the return leg complete (full round trip is 3000 ms)
The star is still alive after the full round-trip window, not despawned before returning
DISCRIMINATING: the star has returned close to its origin, not stuck or vanished mid-path
